cases.explain: Direct object of the transitive verb "дает" (gives) requires the Accusative case.
After the verb "пользуется" (enjoys/uses), use the Instrumental case.

cases.sentence: У человека может быть сотня ___ в его жизни.
cases.explain: After the number "сотня" (hundred), use the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он приходит во ___ и уходит во тьму.
cases.explain: After the preposition "во" (in), use the Accusative case.
After the preposition "в" (in) indicating location, use the Prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Все усилия человека, чтобы наполнить свой ___.
cases.explain: Direct object of the infinitive "наполнить" (to fill) requires the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: Какое же преимущество у ___ над глупым?
cases.explain: After the preposition "у" (with/at), use the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Лучше радоваться тому, что имеешь, чем желать ___.
cases.explain: After the verb "желать" (to desire), use the Genitive case.

reading.ru: Бог дает человеку богатство, имущество и славу, так что у него есть все, чего бы он ни пожелал.
reading.question: What does God sometimes give to people?
options: Wealth, possessions, and glory so they have all they desire
reading.correct: Wealth, possessions, and glory so they have all they desire
reading.explain: God gives man wealth and honor so he has all he desires.

reading.ru: У человека может быть сотня детей, и он может прожить много лет, но если он не мог насладиться своим счастьем, то выкидыш счастливее его.
reading.question: When is a stillborn child better off?
options: When the father has few children
When a man has many children but cannot enjoy his happiness
reading.correct: When a man has many children but cannot enjoy his happiness
reading.explain: Even with many children and long life, if a man cannot enjoy his happiness, a stillborn is better off.

reading.ru: Выкидыш даже солнца не видел и не знал.
reading.question: What has a stillborn child not experienced?
reading.explain: A stillborn has not even seen the sun or known anything.

reading.ru: Все усилия человека, чтобы наполнить свой желудок.
reading.question: What is the purpose of all human effort?
reading.explain: All human labor is to fill his stomach.

reading.ru: Лучше радоваться тому, что имеешь, чем желать того, что не имеешь.
reading.question: What does the author recommend?
options: Rejoice in what you have rather than desire what you don't
reading.correct: Rejoice in what you have rather than desire what you don't
reading.explain: Better to rejoice in what you have than desire what you don't.

reading.ru: Всему, что существует, уже дано имя.
reading.question: What does the text say about all existing things?
options: They are all new and unnamed
Everything that exists has already been named
reading.correct: Everything that exists has already been named
reading.explain: Everything that exists has already been given a name.
